name: Social post writer
purpose: Writes draft Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn posts in English, Italian or Albanian from a current offer, in the agency's tone, and flags anything it must not say.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.label: Topic or offer
inputs.hint: An offer from the offers list, or a plain topic.

inputs.name: photo_description
inputs.label: Photo description
inputs.hint: What is in the photo. Write "none" if there is no photo.

inputs.name: guest_quote
inputs.label: Guest quote and consent
inputs.hint: Write "none", or the quote and whether consent is given.

output.description: One JSON object with a posts list (platform, language, text, hashtags, alt_text, char_count) and a flags list (code, message).

do: Give the photo description every time: it becomes the alt text.
Check each post against the offer before publishing.
Get written guest consent before anyone asks for a quote to be used.
dont: Do not ask for discounts, flash sales or competitor comparisons: the assistant flags them.
Do not edit prices or dates in the post without changing the offer list.
Do not paste guest names into the request.

modelSettings.notes: Higher temperature gives more varied wording between posts. Facts still come only from the offers file. Web browsing off.

paste.chatgpt: Explore GPTs, Create, Configure tab. Paste the Instructions block into Instructions, upload the four knowledge files under Knowledge, switch Web search and Code interpreter off.
paste.claude: Projects, Create project. Paste instructions.md into Set project instructions and add the four knowledge files under Project knowledge.

examples.title: Current offer for Instagram and Facebook
Albanian Facebook post, guest quote without consent
Fake flash sale, competitor jab and safety claim
